steps.title: Bem-vindo: Daily Life - Volume 28
steps.text: In this B2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Daily Life". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: Sorry, I'm running late because of the traffic.
I love sleeping in on weekends.
I read in my spare time.
